data.long_meaning: In Greek, Aney is derived from the word 'anēr' meaning man or husband. However, in the context of Christian and spiritual traditions, the name Aney is associated with the divine feminine and signifies grace, mercy, and compassion. The name Aney carries the meaning “Grace, Mercy, Compassion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aney usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, mercy, compassion and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aney total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
